steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Shut the door! Block them!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know what to do! Stop bossing me around!!!
Bang—With a loud slam, the basement door is tightly shut. After the frantic slamming, the footsteps gradually fade away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are there any other exits this way?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: No. An-Anne deliberately requested not to have any so as to isolate the Maniatic patients. Nothing has ever gone wrong. But what just happened?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Those patients have been treated in the quarantine area. Wh-why did they suddenly...

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: I'm so scared. Anne, Dr. Iron. I'm scared...
The face of the young nurse is pale while her body shivers.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...S-sorry. I know that. Stop... stop thinking...
You hold the girl's hand until her breathing gradually settles down.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Ted? I don't know... but I saw a gangster I didn't know who went down after shooting the guard and opening the isolation door.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: How long ago was that? Has he left?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: I don't remember, but... he hasn't come out yet. I'm sure. Only monsters came out.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Ted's still down there, Chief. We've still got time.
You are about to get up when the nurse grabs your sleeve.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Did something happen down there? What happened to Anne? Many doctors went down to help. Will they be fine?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: And that girl isn't doing well. I'm worried.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That Sinner is—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't say anything unnecessary.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry, you little SALVA girl. Your head nurse is a very strong Sinner. She will be fine facing those monsters. Besides...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This idiot-looking Chief is very reliable when troubles come. You can count on him to bring your colleagues and patients back safely.
steps.female_content: This idiot-looking Chief is very reliable when troubles come. You can count on her to bring your colleagues and patients back safely.

steps.content: She pats on her puffed skinny chest and nudges you.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Okay! I'll take care of the patients up there until you guys get back. I won't let them get any more injuries.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Please keep Anne, everyone at SALVA, and the patients safe.
You give her a nod. The Sinners pull open the isolation door. You step in and slam the door shut behind you.
